summary: Thiscall copy of a PAUSE-menu key name string into output buffer a2, selected by an index byte at this+0xC8C. Requires a count at this+0xC88 > 0 to proceed; writes the index to *a3. Indexes below 0x5A select the primary table aPause_0 (16 bytes per entry); indexes above 128 select the secondary table aEmpty_0 via index-128. Returns 1 on copy, 0 when gated or out of range.

operations.description: Block when the key-count field at this+0xC88 is <= 0, returning 0.
Read the key-index byte at this+0xC8C and store it to the output int pointed by a3.
Branch when the index byte is <= 128 (unsigned).
When the index is < 0x5A, take the primary-table copy path.
Copy the string from &aPause_0[16 * index] into a2 via strcpy and return 1.
Return 0 when the index is between 0x5A and 128 inclusive (primary path blocked).
Compute the secondary index v4 = index - 128.
Block the secondary path when v4 >= 0x58, returning 0.
Copy the NUL-terminated string from &aEmpty_0[16 * v4] into a2 byte by byte until a zero byte is copied.
Return 1 after the secondary-table copy completes.

unresolved: Declaring object owning the count at this+0xC88 and index byte at this+0xC8C is not identified.
Exact contents of the aPause_0 and aEmpty_0 string tables are unknown.
